card.name: Female factor in creatinine clearance formula
card.fires_on: The multiplication sign or equals sign right after 0.85 (or after "female") in the Cockcroft-Gault creatinine clearance formula, where females get a correction factor applied to the male value.

modes.label: Times sign after 0.85
modes.description: The × or x that follows 0.85 in the line for females, just before "male value" or "above value".
modes.example: Females: 0.85<< ×>> above value In patients with severe renal failure

modes.label: Inside the female formula
modes.description: The sign or opening bracket right around 0.85 or the female equals sign as the female equation starts.

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward words that refer to the whole of something, such as entire, full or specific, which fits a phrase like "the above value".
card.plain: It lights up at the multiplication sign after 0.85 in the kidney-function formula for women.
